map.如何使用节日倒计时？: How do I use Holiday Countdown?
map.节日倒计时适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Holiday Countdown best for?
map.查看下一个节日的剩余天数: Count down to holidays and special events in days, hours and minutes with a clear display.
map.倒计时天数 = 目标节日日期 − 当前日期（按当地零时计算并向上取整）；公历固定: Countdown days = target holiday date − current date (computed from local midnight and rounded up); fixed Gregorian holidays (New Year's Day on 1 January, Labour Day on 1 May, National Day on 1 October) are taken each year, while lunar holidays (Spring Festival, Mid-Autumn) use the Gregorian date converted from that year's lunar calendar; if the target date has passed, the same holiday next year is used.
map.春节：农历正月初一（按农历计算）: Spring Festival: 1st day of the 1st lunar month (by the lunar calendar)
map.元宵：农历正月十五: Lantern Festival: 15th day of the 1st lunar month
map.端午：农历五月初五: Dragon Boat Festival: 5th day of the 5th lunar month
map.七夕：农历七月初七: Qixi Festival: 7th day of the 7th lunar month
map.中秋：农历八月十五: Mid-Autumn Festival: 15th day of the 8th lunar month
map.重阳：农历九月初九: Double Ninth Festival: 9th day of the 9th lunar month
map.清明：公历 4 月 4-5 日（节气）: Qingming: 4-5 April in the Gregorian calendar (a solar term)
map.元旦、劳动节、国庆节、圣诞节按公历: New Year's Day, Labour Day, National Day and Christmas follow the Gregorian calendar
map.春节/国庆等倒数。: Countdowns to the Spring Festival, National Day and more.
map.春节、中秋等农历节日每年日期不同，按当年日期设置倒数。: Lunar festivals such as the Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival fall on different dates each year, so set the countdown using that year's date.
map.设春节日期 → 显示距节日天数（农历以当年为准）。: Set the Spring Festival date → shows the days remaining (using that year's lunar date).
map.农历每年变？: Does the lunar date change each year?
map.是，春节公历日期逐年不同。: Yes; the Gregorian date of the Spring Festival differs from year to year.
map.农历节日日期每年变吗？: Do lunar festival dates change each year?
map.变。农历与公历不同步，页面展示的是你设定的公历日期；农历节日需先查当年对应的公历: Yes. The lunar and Gregorian calendars are out of step, and the page shows the Gregorian date you set; for lunar festivals look up that year's corresponding Gregorian date first and then set it.
map.节日倒计时是一款日常生活领域的在线工具。日常生活工具，贴近生活，实用便捷。: Holiday Countdown is an online tool in the daily-life category. A daily-life tool that is practical and convenient.
